technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present recovery potential, but pervasive bearish technicals (all MAs bearish, negative MACD, three black crows, below VWAP) and lack of bullish confirmation signals indicate high downside risk; not a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 85 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — moderate amounts, senior member (McCaul) with dual purchases
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) with recent bipartisan congressional purchases 86-87 days ago presents contrarian buy opportunity, though signal age and lack of recent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (302.6), strong dollar pressures multinationals like ACN, and FOMC event just occurred; earnings in 85 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9/14, Williams %R) combined with contrarian congressional buying 86-87 days ago and fear-zone sentiment (15/100) create a classic capitulation setup with asymmetric risk/reward if support at 247.17 holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish technicals (all MAs bearish, price below all key MAs, negative MACD, three black crows pattern, below VWAP), zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 85 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) make this a low-probability entry with multiple failure vectors.

decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (302.6), and strong dollar headwinds combined with earnings risk in 85 days create multiple failure vectors; price could break below 247.17 support into deeper drawdown.
